alternatives.reason: The 10/6 first-deploy runbook, deploy-cloud-run.sh, cloudbuild.yaml and the Secret Manager / service-account wiring exist only because the competition demo needed a live URL. The project withdrew on 2026-10-16. A real Cloud Run deploy would prove that GCP IAM and gcloud flags are wired correctly; it proves nothing about the product's own job (deciding whether a change may advance), and it adds billing, quota and secret-handling work with no reader waiting for the result.

Would give the promotion gate a real Cloud Run revision/digest to read back, but the same read-back can be exercised against a locally running container. The marginal realism does not justify keeping a cloud footprint for a project that is now optimised as an ordinary repo.

Declared deployment records (the current EB-008 / EB-009 state) cannot exercise the parts of the gate that read a live service: healthz, revision identity, digest match, config drift. Running the managed demo application locally as two distinct environments keeps those checks real without any cloud resource.

architecture_impact: ContextRail itself and the managed demo application (demo/order-operations-portal) are deployed only on the developer's machine: `go run`, the existing Dockerfile via `docker run`, or the demo app's own local scripts. No GCP project, billing account, Cloud Run service, Cloud Build trigger, Artifact Registry repo or Secret Manager secret is created for this project.

The product boundary in roadmap.md §2 is unchanged and is now the whole story: ContextRail manages a Project's policy and evidence contract and decides whether a change may advance; it never was, and now explicitly is not, the thing that performs a deployment. Cloud Run stays in the model as the reference environment *type* (standard types, minimum protection, revision/digest identity); it stops being a required execution target.

Deployment evidence for the staging and prod-demo gates comes from two sources only: (a) real Git/CI evidence read back from GitHub, as already exercised in EB-012 (CHG-001 on github.com/williamlabdev/order-operations-portal), and (b) locally running instances of the managed demo application presented as distinct environments. Declared values (EB-008 / EB-009) remain declared and are labelled permanently as such; they are no longer 'to be backfilled after deploy'.

docs/operations/CLOUD_RUN_FIRST_DEPLOY.zh-TW.md, scripts/deploy-cloud-run.sh, cloudbuild.yaml and the GEMINI_API_KEY / service-account wiring in them become dormant reference material. They are kept (deleting them rewrites history and they are self-consistent, see the 2026-10-19 status report), but their header states that they are not a current target.

The 2026-09-27 deferrals recorded in the 0926 handoff as 'not before 10/18' (Project CRUD, scoped invalidation) lose their reason to stay deferred: they are core requirements-management features and are now the natural next work, ahead of any environment integration.

roadmap.md moves to v1.4: G0 drops the official deadline, G1/G3/G4 no longer require a cloud path, §7 item 7 and §8 name local environments, and the §3 week table stays frozen as the original plan per the 2026-10-16 note.
cost_assumptions: Zero cloud spend for this project. The only recurring costs are the developer machine and, if and when the Gemini advisor is exercised, direct Gemini API usage from a local run with GEMINI_API_KEY set in the shell for that command only.

DR-014's price table stays at us-central1 pricing. With no deploy region any more, the previously disclosed us-central1 vs asia-east1 mismatch is moot; CostEstimate.region keeps disclosing the pricing origin as before.
unknowns: How two local instances of the demo application are instantiated and told apart as 'staging' and 'prod-demo' in deployment evidence (separate ports, separate containers, separate state dirs, or a local registry digest). Not decided here; the first local run that records an evidence bundle will settle it.

Whether the Gemini advisor will ever be exercised against the real API. It remains UNVERIFIED (advisor.go, DR-014 unknowns). This decision removes the expectation that it would be verified 'after the 10/6 deploy'; a local run with a real key is now the only path, and it is optional.

Whether scripts/deploy-cloud-run.sh and cloudbuild.yaml should eventually be deleted or moved under docs/planning/history/. Kept for now; revisit if they start to mislead a reader or rot against gcloud flag changes.

Whether a local-only promotion path still satisfies a future design partner's definition of 'environment-aware'. P0's measurement targets (setup time, repeat use, decision quality) do not depend on where the demo application runs, but this has not been tested with an external reader; the reader test itself is still blocked on finding participants (DR-013 / EB-013 G5).
acceptance_criteria: roadmap.md is at v1.4 with G0, G1, G3, G4, §7 item 7 and §8 rewritten so that no gate or assumption requires a cloud resource; the §3 week table is unchanged.

docs/operations/CLOUD_RUN_FIRST_DEPLOY.zh-TW.md and CLOUD_RUN_BASELINE.md carry a dated status line naming DR-015 and stating that they are dormant reference material, with their content otherwise untouched.
The 0926 handoff items 'backfill EB-008/EB-009 with real digests', '10/6 deploy day' and 'record video after deploy' are closed as WON'T DO with a pointer to this record, not left open.

When a local staging / prod-demo run is first recorded, it lands as a new evidence bundle (EB-015 or later) with the actual local invocation and read-back output, and EB-008 / EB-009 are not edited to look like real deployments.

human_decision.reason: William 自己打字的原話，逐字記錄：「我的想法會是不實測 因為我目前沒有要參加比賽 我的重點在於我的系統本身 是不是能夠有一個好的需求管理工具來面對所有的異動 確認是不是可以上架」；追問「ContextRail 自己不部署、demo app 也不真的部署」是否正確時，回覆「都只會在本機部署」。前一句是方向，後一句是本紀錄 selected_option 的直接依據。
